summary: September is summer's quieter end: warm seas, fewer crowds and harvest time in Europe's wine regions.
intro: Once the schools go back, Europe's beaches and cities empty out while the sea is still at its warmest. It's harvest time in the wine regions, and good walking weather returns to the mountains.
The monsoon begins to withdraw from northern India, spring flowers come out in South Africa's west, and in the far north the first northern lights of the season appear as the nights draw in.
